template.title: Signed ({v},{k},{l}) difference set in {group}
template.statement: Find {k} distinct elements d_i of the abelian group G = {group} (written {primary}) and signs s_i = +1 or -1 such that D = sum s_i d_i satisfies D D^(-1) = {n} + {l} G in the group ring: for every nonzero g in G, the sum of s_i s_j over the ordered pairs with d_i - d_j = g is {l}. A signed ({v},{k},{l}) difference set (Gordon, 2023).
template.submission: Text file: {k} lines, one element per line: its sign + or -, then its coordinates in {primary} (integers 0 <= a_c < n_c separated by spaces, in that order).

score: 1 for a signed difference set with these parameters in this group; none is known, so the best known value is 0
best_text: Its existence is Open in Gordon's repository: no such set is known and none has been ruled out, so the best known value is {best}; a valid set scores 1.
holder_sources: the repository's entry for these parameters and group
